component_conditions.inspection_notes: Notes: NO STAINS OR TEARS NORMAL WEAR Typical Vehicle Desc: Clean to very clean with no significant tears, holes or burn marks. Light to no wear. No bare spots.
Notes: NO STAINS OR TEARS NORMAL WEAR Typical Vehicle Desc: Clean to very clean with no significant tears, holes or burn marks. Light to no wear. No bare spots.
Notes: NO SUN DAMAGES, NORMAL WEAR Typical Vehicle Desc: A few small and/or insignificant scratches or gouges. Minimal to no damage to firmly intact and functional components. Light wear.
Notes: NO STAINS OR SOILS NORMAL WEAR Typical Vehicle Desc: Clean to very clean with no significant holes or burn marks. Light to no significant scuffing.

Notes: NO PRIOR DAMAGES NORMAL WEAR Typical Vehicle Desc: Sheet Metal: Few to no dings. No dents. All panels intact and properly aligned. Trim: No broken and/or missing components. No dents. Few to no dings.
Notes: NO CRACKS ON GLASS, NORMAL WEAR Typical Vehicle Desc: Light to no surface scratches. Light to no pitting.
Notes: NO PRIOR DAMAGES ON PANELS NORMAL WEAR Typical Vehicle Desc: Minimal surface chipping and/or a few small scratches. No peeling and/or flaking. Minor to no swirl marks. Light to no fading.
Notes: NO LEAKS SEEN NORMAL WEAR Typical Vehicle Desc: Minor to no seepage. Belts and hoses firm, and may show minimal wear. Minimal to zero dirt and grease in engine compartment.
Notes: NO LEAKS SEEN NORMAL WEAR Typical Vehicle Desc: Fluid slightly discolored. A few areas to no seepage.
Notes: TIRES MEASURE MORE THAN 5.32NDS Typical Vehicle Desc: 41% to 90% of new. Example: Typical new car tires are 11/32, loss measures at 5/32 = 46% (5/11)
